links.outcome: Statement-level concordance of LLM answers with a formal rehabilitation consensus guideline
links.effect: Strict statement-level concordance: GPT-5.6 25/52 (48.1%), Gemini 3.6 Flash 22/52 (42.3%), DeepSeek-V4 10/52 (19.2%), Doubao-2.1 7/52 (13.5%); errors involved weight-bearing, range-of-motion and return-to-sport criteria.
links.quote: Strict statement-level concordance differed more markedly (Cochran's Q = 27.53, p < 0.001): GPT-5.6 achieved 25/52 (48.1%), Gemini 3.6 Flash 22/52 (42.3%), DeepSeek-V4 10/52 (19.2%), and Doubao-2.1 7/52 (13.5%).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing the factual concordance of multiple LLMs against an orthopaedic meniscus rehabilitation consensus statement without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
